members.name: Petilil
evoNotes: In the original hack, a Petilil leveled up by day while holding a Black Belt stays a Petilil because of an error in the hack. The English patch fixes this from rc8: it evolves into Hisuian Lilligant.

members.name: Hisuian Lilligant
evoNotes: In the original hack, a Petilil leveled up by day while holding a Black Belt stays a Petilil because of an error in the hack (a Sun Stone then gives Hisuian Lilligant). The English patch fixes this from rc8: the level-up evolution works.

steps.text: Level up holding Black Belt during the day (4:00–19:59)
